lightningcss.reason: Vite's default CSS minifier, a tool of development: vite requires it, but the build minifies CSS with esbuild, so it handles nothing that ships and puts nothing of its own into the build; its builds for each platform come with it (R03 in app's docs/decisions.md)

axe-core.reason: The checker of accessibility in the tests of the screens, a tool of development: it runs in Chromium under Vitest only, never ships and puts nothing of its own into the build (R11 in app's docs/decisions.md)
